lines.zh: 我在水里滑行，身子拉得很长。
lines.en: I glide through the water, my body drawn long.

lines.zh: 水道的石头被我蹭出响声。
lines.en: The channel stones rasp as I pass.
I follow the bend without surfacing.

lines.zh: 我的身子比这条水道还长。
lines.en: I am longer than this channel.
The weeds part down the middle.

lines.zh: 我游过去，水面起了一道纹。
lines.en: I swim past and the surface ridges.
My body drives itself, segment by segment.
I keep to the bottom of the pool.
I pass beneath the bridge.

lines.zh: 水流被我推得往一边倒。
lines.en: The current bends aside where I push.
I raise my head, then sink again.
I probe forward inch by inch.
I slip beneath the rocks.

lines.zh: 我的身体在水里弯了三次。
lines.en: My body bends three times under water.
I push the water to both sides.

lines.zh: 水底的沙子被我搅起来。
lines.en: I stir up the sand on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我停在深水里，只看得到眼睛。
lines.en: I hover in the deep, only my eyes showing.
Bubbles rise from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我把身子盘在水底的石头上。
lines.en: I coil my body around the sunken stone.

lines.zh: 我的牙关合不拢，露在外面。
lines.en: My jaw won't close; my teeth show.
I go still, and the water settles.
I wait for something to enter the water.
There is light above; I don't go up.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤是一节一节的。
lines.en: My hide is banded in segments.
I swallow a mouthful of water slowly.

lines.zh: 水面静得没有一丝波纹。
lines.en: The surface is still, without a single ripple.
I rest my head in a crack of stone.
I listen to footsteps on the bank.
I wrap my tail around a stone pillar.
Water runs out through my gill slits.
You are standing at the water's edge.

lines.zh: 你脚下的水很浅，我进不去。
lines.en: The water at your feet is too shallow for me.
I see your reflection.

lines.zh: 我数着你在岸上走几步。
lines.en: I count the steps you take on the bank.
I rise, showing only my head.

lines.zh: 这条水道只有一个出口。
lines.en: This channel has one exit.
Your shadow lies on the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着水道绕了你一圈。
lines.en: I circle you along the channel wall.
Do you hear the water moving?
My mouth is bigger than your head.
I retreat into the deep.
A cut opens in my hide.
The wound stings the moment water touches it.
I thrash and the surface breaks.
A ring of red spreads through the water.
That came at my flank.
I draw my body in.
I scraped on the bottom stones.
I grunt once underwater.
I am not leaving yet.
You threw something into the water.
I smell meat.
It sank, and I can reach it.
Throw another one in.
I raise my head and open my mouth.
Not enough. I am large.
Stand further back before you throw.
The splash reached your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 我不要你手里的，我要水里的。
lines.en: I don't want what's in your hand; I want what's in the water.
Don't shake; it might fall in.
You bumped my snout.
I pull back and the water churns.
You push me, and your hand slides off.
You stepped on my back.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把水打到你脸上。
lines.en: I throw my head and water hits your face.
The water pushes you back.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍擦过你的膝盖。
lines.en: My tail fin brushes your knee.
In this channel, I decide.
Are you trying to climb ashore?

lines.zh: 我让开一条缝，只够你站。
lines.en: I open a gap just wide enough for you.

lines.zh: 水里没有谁和我一样长。
lines.en: Nothing in this water is as long as I.
I am alone in this channel.
Say it in the water.
I dislike things on land.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕过来，又松开。
lines.en: I curl my tail over, then let go.
The bottom is too cold for that.
Don't come near my head.

lines.zh: 这是水的事，不是岸的事。
lines.en: This is a matter for the water, not the bank.

lines.zh: 我把身子沉进水底的石缝。
lines.en: I sink into a crack in the channel floor.
Go back to the bank.
I open my jaw and it stays.
This thing is floating in the water.
I swallow. It's passable.
I can find whatever sinks.
I test one bite; it jars my teeth.
I push it up onto the bank for you.
What's in the water is mine.
Too light to matter.
It took two circles to catch it.

lines.zh: 你掉的？掉水里就是我的了。
lines.en: You dropped it? In the water means mine.

lines.zh: 你的脚已经踩进我的水里。
lines.en: Your foot is already in my water.
I am directly below you.
The water will pin you first.
My head has turned toward you.
There is no shallows in this channel.
Do you hear the water?
I could hold you in one bite.
You can't get back to the bank.
I hug the bottom just behind your feet.
The bubbles have multiplied.
I track you along the bottom.

lines.zh: 你踢水的频率我数着呢。
lines.en: I am counting the rhythm of your kicks.
One circle, then another.
I have cut off your way back to shore.
Your feet no longer touch bottom.

lines.zh: 水道的水正朝我这边卷。
lines.en: The channel water curls my way.
No hurry. The water is mine.
You will choke when you gasp.
I close in from the side.
That dark shape behind you is me.
I snap at you.
My teeth cut in from the side.
You are dragged into the water.

lines.zh: 我甩头，你整个人翻过去。
lines.en: I whip my head and you flip over.

lines.zh: 水压着你的身子，我撞上去。
lines.en: The water holds your body, and I ram it.
I ram your legs.
You can't hold onto anything slick.
My body coils around.
The water drags your legs; you can't dodge.
I catch your hem in my teeth.
The surface bulges.
The dark mass in the deep water unfolds.
The deep water here can hide me.
The weeds are still moving.
An eye lights up beneath the weeds.
This channel is newly dug.
My scent is in the stone cracks.
I turn once along the bottom.
Someone walks on the bank.
I stretch my body out.

lines.zh: 水面烫起来，我往底下钻。
lines.en: The surface turns scalding; I dive deeper.
Hitting the water numbs my spine.

lines.zh: 我自己就在水里，可我还是呛了。
lines.en: I live in water, and still I choked.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀起来，我被冲走。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and sweeps me away.
An arrow sinks into my spine.

lines.zh: 咒光在水里散开，刺得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Spell-light spreads in the water and blinds me.
There is little left to eat in this water.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and numbs me whole.

lines.zh: 水没有了，我只能空着往下掉。
lines.en: The water is gone and I fall through nothing.
